# Atlas M42 Multimeter

The Atlas M42 is a handheld digital multimeter for measuring AC and DC voltage, resistance, and continuity.

## Measuring DC voltage

To measure DC voltage with the Atlas M42, connect the black test lead to the COM jack and the red test lead to the VΩ jack. Turn the dial to DC V. Place the probes across the circuit in parallel, then read the value on the display. The maximum DC voltage range is 600 V.

Never measure voltage while the red lead is in the current input jack. Disconnect the probes before changing the dial setting.

## Measuring resistance

Disconnect power from the circuit. Connect the black lead to COM and the red lead to VΩ, select the resistance setting, and place the probes across the component.
